minutes.headline: Sewer Commission ratified hiring a new business manager, Andrew (surname garbled), to start January 6.
minutes.summary: The commission discussed and ratified the hiring of a new business manager after interviews and a trial shift shadowing the billing work. It also approved the second-quarter FY25 billing commitment, discussed an appointed member who has not attended, and heard DPW updates on billing, manhole repair and line repairs. Members also discussed sewer rates paid to neighboring towns.

votes.motion: Ratify the hiring of Andrew (surname garbled) as the new business manager for the Sewer Commission.
Approve the second-quarter FY25 billing commitment.

budget_items.topic: Second quarter FY25 sewer billing commitment
budget_items.what_was_said: The commitment for the second quarterly billing was read out and put to a vote, to be signed and sent to the town accountant and treasurer.

budget_items.topic: Sewer rates paid to neighboring towns
budget_items.what_was_said: Members said rising costs for sending sewage to the neighboring towns drove recent bill increases, and that the rates are negotiated under multi-year agreements that allow increases. A town treatment plant was raised, with the outfall location noted as a challenge.
A consultant was brought in for one afternoon to help get the billing out, and a few calculation errors had to be corrected.
The bid went out and a contract is in place, with work expected in spring.

budget_items.topic: Line repair at Dana Street Station
budget_items.what_was_said: A price will be sought for the same work at Dana Street, hoping it comes down given the contractor's experience.

decisions.decision: The new business manager will start January 6 if ratified, with a list of competencies to be reviewed at the first month, three months and five months.
The chair will look into whether personnel matters, such as reviews, should be handled in executive session.
Members will explore bylaws to deal with a non-attending appointed member, bring it to the select board, and revisit next month; the member will first be emailed.
Agreed to reach back out to prior candidates for the assistant position soon rather than waiting.
No December 24 meeting; next meetings January 14 (hybrid), January 28 (Zoom) and February 11 at 7 pm (hybrid).

why_it_matters: Sewer bills reflect what the town pays neighboring towns to treat its sewage, and those rates are set by multi-year agreements that allow increases, so further rises are possible.
The quarterly billing commitment is the step that turns rates into the bills residents receive, and the minutes cannot confirm from the captions that it passed.
